question: Which of the following is a unit of distance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Light year.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **unit **of **length **used to express **astronomical distances **is the **light year**, which is roughly comparable to **5.88 trillion miles** or** 9.46 trillion kilometres.**
 
• According to the** International Astronomical Union (IAU),** a light-year is the distance that light travels in a vacuum in **one Julian year (365.25 days).**
 
• Since "light-year" incorporates the term "year," which designates a unit of measurement for time, it is occasionally misinterpreted as a** unit of time.**
 
• The light-year is most typically used to depict distances to stars and other distances on a** galactic scale**, especially in non-specialist contexts and popular science publications.
 
• The measuring unit most frequently used in professional astronomy is the **parsec**, which is derived from astrometry and equals **3.26 light-years. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Newton: **

 
 
• A **newton **is a unit of **force **in the International System of Units (symbol: N).
 
• **1 kgm/s²** is the force that accelerates a mass of** **one kilogramme** **by one metre per second square.
 
• It is named after **Isaac Newton.**
 
 
 
• **Watt:**
 
 
• **​**The **electrical power **determined in **Watts **is the equivalent of one ampere under one volt of pressure.
 
 
 
• **Joule:**
 
 
• **​**The **work performed **by a **force **of one newton acting through one metre is equivalent to one **joule**, a unit of work or energy in the International System of Units (SI).
